questions.question: How should we handle the uncommitted .entire/settings.json change (Entire review profiles, unrelated to this work)?

options.label: Leave it alone
options.description: Branch off main with the file still modified; never stage it in our commits.

options.label: Commit it to main first
options.description: Separate chore commit before we start.

options.label: Stash it
options.description: Stash now, restore when we're done.

questions.question: How do we get the overlay to stay visible without flickering?

options.label: Draw on display after push
options.description: Cheapest. The text may flicker on slow-frame hacks, since each pushImage erases it. Try it on the device and see.

options.label: Blit a stamped copy
options.description: Copy the canvas to a scratch buffer, stamp the text in, then push that. No flicker, but costs another 434 KB of PSRAM and a memcpy per frame.

options.label: Redraw text into canvas, then restore
options.description: Save the pixels under the text, stamp, push, restore. Needs only a small buffer and no flicker, but a little more code.

questions.question: Issues 4 and 15 on one branch with one PR, or separate?

options.label: One branch, two commits, one PR
options.description: They share the text-overlay code, so this avoids duplicating or stacking branches. PR says Fixes #4 and Fixes #15.

options.label: Two branches/PRs
options.description: Do #4 first, then #15 stacked on it after merge.
